physical_description.heritage: Truly cosmopolitan blend: South Asian foundation (42.7%) combined with substantial Hispanic/Latin American (37.9%), Middle Eastern (14.7%), Sub-Saharan African (3.1%), and East Asian (1.6%) ancestry. This creates a complexion and facial structure that defies simple categorizationâ€”warm golden-brown skin with olive and amber undertones, bone structure showing the angular strength of South Asian and Middle Eastern heritage softened by Hispanic warmth and refined by subtle East Asian geometry. The result is striking without being exotic: a face that belongs to the globalized future.

physical_description.hair_color: Steel gray with hints of dark brown at the roots
physical_description.eye_color: Left eye: dark brown, natural. Right eye: matte gunmetal chrome with faint amber lens-flare beneath the surface

Moderate, well-defined cheekbones, straight nose with defined nostrils, deep-set eye sockets that give him a perpetually observant expression. The lower face carries warmth from Hispanic and Sub-Saharan ancestry. Skin shows age gracefullyâ€”fine lines around the mouth and temples, minimal scarring on the face itself. Close-shaved jaw, minimal facial hair. No vanity in grooming, only maintenance.

physical_description.visible_augmentations: Right eye is unmistakably cyberneticâ€”matte chrome casing with a faintly visible aperture mechanism and amber-tinted optical sensor. No effort to conceal it. The augmentation is professional-grade, industrial aesthetic. Suggests additional augmentation beneath clothing that isn't immediately visible.

Eyes track people and exits constantly, habit made instinct. When stationary, he creates an impression of coiled potential rather than relaxation.

Custom-fitted jacket with subtle reinforcement panels at the shoulders. Expensive boots broken in from real use, not display. No logos, no flash, no jewelry.
